Resolves #22016

🌿 A depth-1 update can no longer clear a flag it never rendered.

A container's update now clears `needsVdomUpdate` only on the descendants its depth covers: all of them at depth -1, none at depth 1, one level less per level down, plus the merged children it expands at their own depth. Before, a depth-1 update of an ancestor cleared the flag of a descendant that still owed an update, so that update never ran and every `promiseUpdate()` merged into it stayed pending.

Evidence: L3 (an e2e in a real App Worker, red on dev) → L3 required (AC-1). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/ShallowUpdateFlags.spec.mjs` (registered in `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`): after a depth-1 update of the root, a host change merged into a staged container renders, and its promise settles once the container wakes on its flag. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/vdom/ShallowUpdateFlags.spec.mjs`, the same path through real `Container` and `VDomUpdate` instances, and a deep update that still clears every descendant it renders. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. This PR first targeted #21974. The e2e found a second path to the same hold, which this PR does not fix, so its close target is #22016, and #21974 stays open with both paths described.

## Test Evidence

- e2e red proof: on dev the arm fails with `the host update merged into the intermediate never settled`; on this head it passes.
- Outside this PR: a depth -1 ancestor flight (a fresh container keeps that depth until its own flight) renders the host but collects none of the callbacks merged into the staged container, so the promise still hangs; Sophie's sparse depth-2 case has the same shape. Keeping a covered flag while callbacks wait fixed that arm and broke DockReload and DockLock (3 failures; 17/17 without it), because a kept flag with no flight scheduled swallows later merges. That fix belongs in the carrying flight, on #21974.
- Consumer sweep across the org checkouts: nothing overrides `afterSetNeedsVdomUpdate`; neo-pro's `DetailLayer.spec.mjs` wraps `getVdomUpdatePayload` and runs against this checkout: 19/19.
